name: Demand Clusters
author: m4d5hr1mp
description:
**demand-clusters shows you where the demand on your map starts and where it ends.**

## What it does

Select a group of demand points with a box. Give the group a name and a colour. The mod then shows
the points at the other end of each demand pair. You see which homes send commuters to your
selection. You also see which workplaces receive them.

## Filters

Each group has its own filters:

- Show or hide the demand to the jobs in the group.
- Show or hide the demand from the homes in the group.
- Show or hide the regular home-to-work demand pairs.
- Show or hide the airport demand pairs.
- Show or hide the student demand pairs.

## How the points look

A point shows as a dot or as an icon. An icon shows a house, a briefcase or a mixed-use building.
A label shows the pops and the jobs at each point. You set the size of a point.

## Clusters

When points are near to each other, the mod puts them into one bubble. The bubble shows how many
points it contains. The grid uses real distances on the ground. It does not use distances on the
screen. Set one grid size for station work. Set a second grid size for line work.

## Folders

Put your groups into folders. One click shows or hides all the groups in a folder.

## Notes

The mod draws its own layer on the map. It does not change the demand data of the game. The mod
keeps your groups and your settings on your computer.
